definition: at a lower speed than others
description: A riverside path on an autumn day, with yellow trees, a stone bridge and boats on the water. A young woman in a lilac top crouches and pulls hard on a lead, but her chubby bulldog sits almost still on the path. Behind them a young woman in a coral top and two young men run towards the camera and race past close by, and a cyclist rides away along the path. The young woman laughs while the bulldog stays where it is. Dry leaves lie on the path.

taps.phrase: to tug hard on the lead
